name: object_contact_v1
changed_factors: MolmoPoint is queried on the same-frame green-arrow RGB image without a mask
decoded points are admitted by a finite RGB-D world-distance gate from the arrow tail
each admitted point receives an independent 0.015 m local RGB-D support patch
prompt: Point to visible grasp contact locations on the {noun} at the tail, or start, of the green arrow. Ignore the arrowhead and destination. Choose locations where a parallel-jaw gripper can descend from above, straddle the object, and close without touching nearby objects or support surfaces. Point only on the {noun}.
